name: threshold_mode_exclusive
description: HALO-inspired BCI threshold family: two signed 8-bit threshold variants (movement above-threshold and seizure below-threshold detection) selected by mode are equivalent to one signed comparator with a multiplexed threshold operand and relation configuration.
scheduling_contract: mode selects exactly one threshold variant per transaction; only the active variant's output is required

interfaces.input: signed 8-bit sample x, signed 8-bit thresholds t0,t1, and mode
interfaces.fixed_point: two's-complement signed 8-bit sample and thresholds; boolean comparison result

mode_switch.preconditions: mode is stable for the transaction

stimulus.provenance: Yosys SAT exploration; synthetic HALO-inspired threshold stimulus

constraints.schedule: one threshold variant is active per transaction
